MVCD.description: Moving Load Code (MVCD). Single-entry setting (key 1) that selects the national design code governing the moving-load database; the CODE field drives the entire record.

CODE.description: National design code for moving loads. Case-insensitive; the value must be one of the listed wire strings (note the embedded spaces, e.g. "AASHTO STANDARD", "AASHTO LRFD(PENDOT)", "SOUTH AFRICA"). "TRANS" selects the transitional/custom code path.
